Text: A Crane Head that extends a Crane's working area from 3×3 to 5×5. Place it on top of a Crane Section.
Whoever designed this insisted the extra reach was for efficiency. The extra spinning was the real fun.
Must be placed on a Crane Section.
A Crane Head that launches rubble away from the mast instead of storing it. Place it on top of a Crane Section.
Hooman used it to launch 90 kg projectiles over 300 meters.
